game.title: GYANU
game.subtitle: THE FLAG HOSTING MISSION
game.tagline: Gather 16 city districts, evade security, and host the flag atop the watchtower.

briefing.title: THE CITY NEEDS YOU
briefing.body: Bring friendly neighbors together across the city. Keep a low profile around security, reach the secured assembly ground, climb the watchtower stairs, then host the supplied flag at the pole. The flag is hosted only when the final ceremony completes.

progress.title: MISSION PROGRESS
progress.body: Discover each place, bring its friendly crowd together, and unlock the flag-hosting zone.
about.title: ABOUT THE MISSION
about.body: A single-player exploration and stealth adventure through an original, Old Delhi–inspired city. The mission is to gather neighbors, evade patrols, climb the watchtower and host the supplied flag.
about.privacy: Mission progress and settings are stored locally in this browser. No account, ads, gameplay analytics, or game backend are used. GitHub Pages may keep standard hosting logs under its own policies.
privacy.title: PRIVACY
privacy.body: The game saves mission progress and settings in your browser storage. It does not request identity, contact, location, payment, or account information. Clearing this browser's site data removes the local save. The site is served over HTTPS by GitHub Pages.
accessibility.title: ACCESSIBILITY
accessibility.body: The interface uses readable high-contrast text, labels as well as color for progress, keyboard focus, adjustable look sensitivity, touch controls, reduced-motion support, and subtitles/prompts. Use Settings to adjust these options.
credits.title: CREDITS
credits.body: Original game concept and supplied Gyanu flag artwork. Character and bazaar GLB models were created for this project; the remaining city kit is original procedural Three.js geometry. Typeface: ManusCC0 (CC0 1.0). Libraries: Three.js (MIT) and Rapier (Apache-2.0).
credits.fonts: Three.js · original game assets · built for this mission
